package com.sherifradwan.ancnative.model

data class PreviousDeliveryCounts(
    val cesarean: Int,
    val vaginal: Int,
    val stillbirth: Int,
    val earlyLoss: Int,
)

private val CS_WORD_REGEX = Regex("""\b(?:CS|Cesarean)\b""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
private val VAGINAL_WORD_REGEX = Regex("""\b(?:SVD|Vaginal)\b""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)

fun isStillbirth(pregnancy: DemoPreviousPregnancy): Boolean {
    val text = pregnancy.outcomeText
    return pregnancy.outcome == "Stillbirth" ||
        (text != null && (text.contains("Stillbirth", ignoreCase = true) || text.contains("IUFD", ignoreCase = true)))
}

fun isEarlyLoss(pregnancy: DemoPreviousPregnancy): Boolean {
    val text = pregnancy.outcomeText
    return pregnancy.outcome == "EarlyPregnancyLoss" ||
        (text != null && (text.contains("Miscarriage", ignoreCase = true) || text.contains("Loss", ignoreCase = true)))
}

fun previousDeliveryCounts(pregnancies: List<DemoPreviousPregnancy>): PreviousDeliveryCounts {
    var cesarean = 0
    var vaginal = 0
    var stillbirth = 0
    var earlyLoss = 0

    for (p in pregnancies) {
        val bm = p.birthMethod?.trim()
        val db = p.deliveryBy?.trim()

        val isStructCs = bm.equals("Cesarean", ignoreCase = true) || db.equals("CS", ignoreCase = true)
        val isStructVag = bm.equals("Vaginal", ignoreCase = true) || db.equals("Vaginal", ignoreCase = true)

        if (isStructCs) {
            cesarean++
        } else if (isStructVag) {
            vaginal++
        } else if (bm.isNullOrBlank() && db.isNullOrBlank()) {
            val text = p.outcomeText
            if (text != null) {
                if (CS_WORD_REGEX.containsMatchIn(text)) {
                    cesarean++
                } else if (VAGINAL_WORD_REGEX.containsMatchIn(text)) {
                    vaginal++
                }
            }
        }

        if (isStillbirth(p)) {
            stillbirth++
        }

        if (isEarlyLoss(p)) {
            earlyLoss++
        }
    }

    return PreviousDeliveryCounts(
        cesarean = cesarean,
        vaginal = vaginal,
        stillbirth = stillbirth,
        earlyLoss = earlyLoss,
    )
}

private fun pluralize(count: Int, singular: String, plural: String): String =
    "$count " + if (count == 1) singular else plural

fun previousDeliverySummary(patient: DemoPatient): String {
    val g = patient.gravida ?: 1L
    val p = patient.parity ?: 0L
    val a = patient.abortion ?: 0L
    val pregnancies = patient.previousPregnancies
    val c = previousDeliveryCounts(pregnancies)

    return when {
        g == 1L && p == 0L && a == 0L && pregnancies.isEmpty() -> "Primigravida"
        p == 0L && pregnancies.isEmpty() -> "P0 · No prior deliveries"
        c.cesarean > 0 || c.vaginal > 0 -> {
            val parts = mutableListOf<String>()
            if (c.cesarean > 0) parts.add("${c.cesarean} CS")
            if (c.vaginal > 0) parts.add("${c.vaginal} SVD")
            val routes = parts.joinToString(", ")
            val iufd = if (c.stillbirth > 0) " · ${c.stillbirth} IUFD" else ""
            "Prev $routes$iufd"
        }
        c.stillbirth > 0 -> "Prior Stillbirth (IUFD)"
        c.earlyLoss > 0 -> pluralize(c.earlyLoss, "Prior Miscarriage", "Prior Miscarriages")
        p > 0L -> "Parous (P$p)"
        pregnancies.isNotEmpty() -> pluralize(pregnancies.size, "Prior Pregnancy", "Prior Pregnancies")
        else -> "No prior deliveries"
    }
}

@Composable
fun PreviousPregnancyEditor(
    state: AncState,
    route: AncRoute.PreviousPregnancyEditor,
    onEvent: (AncEvent) -> Unit,
) {
    val patient = state.patient(route.patientId) ?: return
    val draft = state.pregnancyDraft?.takeIf {
        it.patientId == route.patientId && it.pregnancyId == route.pregnancyId
    } ?: return
    val enabled = state.savePhase == SavePhase.IDLE || state.savePhase == SavePhase.ERROR

    EditorPage(
        title = if (draft.basePregnancyRevision == null) {
            stringResource(R.string.add_previous_pregnancy)
        } else {
            stringResource(R.string.correct_previous_pregnancy)
        },
        subtitle = "${patient.displayName} · Previous Pregnancy History & Outcomes",
        tag = "previousPregnancyEditor",
    ) {
        GenericEditorErrorCard(draft.errors.isNotEmpty(), state)

        // CARD 1: TIMING & PREGNANCY BASICS
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant.copy(alpha = 0.5f)),
            elevation = CardDefaults.cardElevation(defaultElevation = 1.dp),
        ) {
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = "1. Pregnancy Timing, Type & Location",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                )

                ClinicalDateField(
                    value = draft.values.dateText,
                    onValueChange = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.DATE_TEXT, it)) },
                    label = stringResource(R.string.entered_date_text),
                    tag = "pregnancyDateText",
                    enabled = enabled,
                    showTodayButton = false,
                )

                EditorField(
                    value = draft.values.outcomeText,
                    onValueChange = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.OUTCOME_TEXT, it)) },
                    label = stringResource(R.string.entered_outcome_text),
                    tag = "pregnancyOutcomeText",
                    enabled = enabled,
                )

                ChoiceGroup(
                    label = stringResource(R.string.pregnancy_type),
                    selected = draft.values.pregnancyType,
                    choices = PatientVocabulary.pregnancyTypes.toList(),
                    enabled = enabled,
                    tagPrefix = "pregnancyType",
                    onSelected = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.PREGNANCY_TYPE, it)) },
                )

                EditorField(
                    value = draft.values.otherDetails,
                    onValueChange = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.OTHER_DETAILS, it)) },
                    label = stringResource(R.string.other_details),
                    tag = "pregnancyOtherDetails",
                    enabled = enabled,
                )

                EditorField(
                    value = draft.values.placeAndDoctor,
                    onValueChange = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.PLACE_AND_DOCTOR, it)) },
                    label = stringResource(R.string.place_and_doctor),
                    tag = "pregnancyPlaceDoctor",
                    enabled = enabled,
                )
            }
        }

        // CARD 2: DELIVERY MODE & CLINICAL OUTCOME
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant.copy(alpha = 0.5f)),
            elevation = CardDefaults.cardElevation(defaultElevation = 1.dp),
        ) {
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = "2. Delivery Mode & Clinical Outcome",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                )

                ChoiceGroup(
                    label = stringResource(R.string.historical_delivery_mode),
                    selected = draft.values.deliveryBy,
                    choices = PatientVocabulary.deliveryModes.toList(),
                    enabled = enabled,
                    tagPrefix = "deliveryBy",
                    onSelected = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.DELIVERY_BY, it)) },
                )

                ChoiceGroup(
                    label = stringResource(R.string.structured_outcome),
                    selected = draft.values.outcome,
                    choices = PatientVocabulary.pregnancyOutcomes.toList(),
                    enabled = enabled,
                    tagPrefix = "pregnancyOutcome",
                    onSelected = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.OUTCOME, it)) },
                )

                if (draft.values.outcome == "LiveBirth" || draft.values.outcome == "Stillbirth") {
                    ChoiceGroup(
                        label = stringResource(R.string.birth_method),
                        selected = draft.values.birthMethod,
                        choices = PatientVocabulary.birthMethods.toList(),
                        enabled = enabled,
                        tagPrefix = "birthMethod",
                        onSelected = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.BIRTH_METHOD, it)) },
                    )
                }

                if (draft.values.outcome == "EarlyPregnancyLoss") {
                    ChoiceGroup(
                        label = stringResource(R.string.loss_management),
                        selected = draft.values.lossManagement,
                        choices = PatientVocabulary.lossManagementMethods.toList(),
                        enabled = enabled,
                        tagPrefix = "lossManagement",
                        onSelected = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.LOSS_MANAGEMENT, it)) },
                    )
                }

                if (draft.values.outcome == "TerminationOfPregnancy") {
                    ChoiceGroup(
                        label = stringResource(R.string.termination_method),
                        selected = draft.values.terminationMethod,
                        choices = PatientVocabulary.terminationMethods.toList(),
                        enabled = enabled,
                        tagPrefix = "terminationMethod",
                        onSelected = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.TERMINATION_METHOD, it)) },
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // CARD 3: CLINICIAN AUDIT & VERIFICATION
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant.copy(alpha = 0.5f)),
            elevation = CardDefaults.cardElevation(defaultElevation = 1.dp),
        ) {
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = "3. Clinician Documentation & Audit",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                )

                EditorField(
                    value = draft.values.clinicianId,
                    onValueChange = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.CLINICIAN_ID, it)) },
                    label = stringResource(R.string.clinician_id_required),
                    tag = "pregnancyClinicianId",
                    enabled = enabled,
                    singleLine = true,
                    error = PatientValidationError.CLINICIAN_ID_REQUIRED in draft.errors,
                )

                if (PatientValidationError.OUTCOME_METHOD_MISMATCH in draft.errors) {
                    Text(
                        stringResource(R.string.outcome_method_mismatch),
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // Security Vault Indicator
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 4.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
            Icon(
                Icons.Default.Lock,
                contentDescription = null,
                tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.tertiary,
                modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp),
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
            Text(
                text = "Previous pregnancy records encrypted and digitally signed · Tamper-Evident Local Storage",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            )
        }

        EditorActions(
            enabled = enabled,
            saveTag = "savePregnancy",
            onCancel = { onEvent(AncEvent.CancelEditor) },
            onSave = { onEvent(AncEvent.SubmitPreviousPregnancy) },
        )
    }
}

data class PreviousDeliveryCounts(
    val cesarean: Int,
    val vaginal: Int,
    val stillbirth: Int,
    val earlyLoss: Int,
)

private val CS_WORD_REGEX = Regex("""\b(?:CS|Cesarean)\b""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
private val VAGINAL_WORD_REGEX = Regex("""\b(?:SVD|Vaginal)\b""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)

fun isStillbirth(pregnancy: DemoPreviousPregnancy): Boolean {
    val text = pregnancy.outcomeText
    return pregnancy.outcome == "Stillbirth" ||
        (text != null && (text.contains("Stillbirth", ignoreCase = true) || text.contains("IUFD", ignoreCase = true)))
}

fun isEarlyLoss(pregnancy: DemoPreviousPregnancy): Boolean {
    val text = pregnancy.outcomeText
    return pregnancy.outcome == "EarlyPregnancyLoss" ||
        (text != null && (text.contains("Miscarriage", ignoreCase = true) || text.contains("Loss", ignoreCase = true)))
}

fun previousDeliveryCounts(pregnancies: List<DemoPreviousPregnancy>): PreviousDeliveryCounts {
    var cesarean = 0
    var vaginal = 0
    var stillbirth = 0
    var earlyLoss = 0

    for (p in pregnancies) {
        val bm = p.birthMethod?.trim()
        val db = p.deliveryBy?.trim()

        val isStructCs = bm.equals("Cesarean", ignoreCase = true) || db.equals("CS", ignoreCase = true)
        val isStructVag = bm.equals("Vaginal", ignoreCase = true) || db.equals("Vaginal", ignoreCase = true)

        if (isStructCs) {
            cesarean++
        } else if (isStructVag) {
            vaginal++
        } else if (bm.isNullOrBlank() && db.isNullOrBlank()) {
            val text = p.outcomeText
            if (text != null) {
                if (CS_WORD_REGEX.containsMatchIn(text)) {
                    cesarean++
                } else if (VAGINAL_WORD_REGEX.containsMatchIn(text)) {
                    vaginal++
                }
            }
        }

        if (isStillbirth(p)) {
            stillbirth++
        }

        if (isEarlyLoss(p)) {
            earlyLoss++
        }
    }

    return PreviousDeliveryCounts(
        cesarean = cesarean,
        vaginal = vaginal,
        stillbirth = stillbirth,
        earlyLoss = earlyLoss,
    )
}

private fun pluralize(count: Int, singular: String, plural: String): String =
    "$count " + if (count == 1) singular else plural

fun previousDeliverySummary(patient: DemoPatient): String {
    val g = patient.gravida ?: 1L
    val p = patient.parity ?: 0L
    val a = patient.abortion ?: 0L
    val pregnancies = patient.previousPregnancies
    val c = previousDeliveryCounts(pregnancies)

    return when {
        g == 1L && p == 0L && a == 0L && pregnancies.isEmpty() -> "Primigravida"
        p == 0L && pregnancies.isEmpty() -> "P0 · No prior deliveries"
        c.cesarean > 0 || c.vaginal > 0 -> {
            val parts = mutableListOf<String>()
            if (c.cesarean > 0) parts.add("${c.cesarean} CS")
            if (c.vaginal > 0) parts.add("${c.vaginal} SVD")
            val routes = parts.joinToString(", ")
            val iufd = if (c.stillbirth > 0) " · ${c.stillbirth} IUFD" else ""
            "Prev $routes$iufd"
        }
        c.stillbirth > 0 -> "Prior Stillbirth (IUFD)"
        c.earlyLoss > 0 -> pluralize(c.earlyLoss, "Prior Miscarriage", "Prior Miscarriages")
        p > 0L -> "Parous (P$p)"
        pregnancies.isNotEmpty() -> pluralize(pregnancies.size, "Prior Pregnancy", "Prior Pregnancies")
        else -> "No prior deliveries"
    }
}

                    tag = "pregnancyOutcomeText",

                ChoiceGroup(
                    label = stringResource(R.string.pregnancy_type),

                    enabled = enabled,
                    tagPrefix = "pregnancyType",
                    onSelected = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.PREGNANCY_TYPE, it)) },

                EditorField(
                    value = draft.values.otherDetails,
                    onValueChange = { onEvent(AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged(PregnancyDraftField.OTHER_DETAILS, it)) },
                    label = stringResource(R.string.other_details),
                    tag = "pregnancyOtherDetails",

            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant.copy(alpha = 0.5f)),

            Column(

                    tagPrefix = "pregnancyOutcome",

            enabled = enabled,
            saveTag = "savePregnancy",
            onCancel = { onEvent(AncEvent.CancelEditor) },
            onSave = { onEvent(AncEvent.SubmitPreviousPregnancy) },
        )
    }

private fun PatientAttentionRow(
    clinicalAttention: String?,
    severeBp: SevereBpAttention?,
) {
    if (clinicalAttention == null && severeBp == null) return

    val isDark = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface.luminance() < 0.5f
    Spacer(Modifier.height(2.dp))
    Row(
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .background(if (isDark) TagAttentionDarkBg else TagAttentionBg)
            .border(1.dp, if (isDark) TagAttentionDarkBorder else TagAttentionBorder, RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
    ) {
        Icon(

            contentDescription = "Clinical Attention",

            modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp),

        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),

            if (severeBp != null) {
                Text(
                    text = stringResource(R.string.bp_attention_severe, severeBp.bloodPressure, severeBp.date),

                    fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                    color = if (isDark) TagAttentionDarkText else TagAttentionText,
                    maxLines = 2,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,

            if (clinicalAttention != null) {
                Text(
                    text = clinicalAttention,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                    color = if (isDark) TagAttentionDarkText else TagAttentionText,
                    maxLines = 4,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
